claim: Does the learned repeated visit move conditional support toward the correct verdict at a real generated answer boundary?
population: The 88 enrolled logic and practical requests on the trained model. Analyze every completed final turn containing a closed reasoning field and a subsequent nonblank answer token. Record exclusions with their reason. Published gold enters only the computation of a post-hoc contrast. No parameters, decisions or prompts change.
measurement: Use the exact archived conversational prompt and generated prefix up to the first nonblank visible answer token. Perform one ordinary unmodified two-visit forward on that prompt and record both visit exits with native observers. Project both through the same final normalization and vocabulary matrix. Compute gold leading-token logit minus logsumexp of the other two canonical leading tokens. Compare this quantity between visits and report the fraction reaching the 0.25-nat training margin. Disclose actual emitted vs replay argmax agreement, since single-block prefill may differ in rounding from cached incremental decoding. No answer generation, extra benchmark arm or matched K1 fit.
status: Descriptive mechanism diagnostic, frozen during the blind primary stream. No promotion decision depends on this readout.
